title: Ensure 'Configure validation of ROCA-vulnerable WHfB keys during authentication' is set to 'Enabled: Block' (DC only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Security Account Manager\Configure validation of ROCA-vulnerable WHfB keys during authentication to 'Enabled: Block'
reason: The 'Return of Coppersmith's attack' (ROCA) vulnerability is a cryptographic weakness. A threat actor can reveal secret keys on certified devices using this library.

title: Ensure 'Configure SAM change password RPC methods policy' is set to 'Enabled: Allow strong encryption change password RPC method only' (DC only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Security Account Manager\Configure SAM change password RPC methods policy to 'Enabled: Allow strong encryption change password RPC method only'
reason: User passwords stored in the SAM should only be changed from a Domain Controller using secure methods.

title: Ensure 'Configure SAM change password RPC methods policy' is set to 'Enabled: Block all change password RPC methods' (MS only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Security Account Manager\Configure SAM change password RPC methods policy to 'Enabled: Block all change password RPC methods'
reason: User passwords stored in the SAM should only be changed from a Domain Controller using secure methods. Member servers should block this.
